approval_source: Explicit user statement in the local human evidence review task
user_statement_verbatim: All Milazzo human evidence reviews are performed - P01 to P10 and B01 to B04. All verified. We can now use these as human verififed evidence and bake into a regression testing the production scientific processing and analysis so if in the future we introduce an error, we would spot it.

B01.title: One pair: normalization and Delta SNR

P01.title: Hit, Miss, Target-only - and excluded cycles

P05.title: One distance bin, three related figures

P08.title: UTC folding at the end of the window

P09.title: Folded SNR: each date-hour gets one vote

P10.title: SNR deviation: subtract each station baseline

B02.title: Histogram weights and a positive outlier

B04.title: Map value: two stations, three observations

scope: Human approval covers the 14 revision-2 cards and their stated arithmetic, evidence selection and interpretation. Exhaustive supporting ledgers and unprinted values are independently calculated support, not a claim of individual human review of every report.
historical_status: Pending statements inside the byte-preserved packet are historical. This separate approval supersedes them without modifying the original packets or decisions.
